mechanism: Donepezil enhances vagal tone through acetylcholinesterase inhibition, which may potentiate dronedarone's bradycardic and AV conduction-slowing effects; both drugs are metabolized via CYP3A4 with potential for increased dronedarone levels.
action: Monitor heart rate and AV conduction intervals (ECG) closely; consider baseline and periodic ECG assessment; dose adjustment of dronedarone may be necessary if bradycardia or conduction abnormalities develop.
